field.label: MAC binding mode
field.help: Protect: an IP address that is bound can only be used by its MAC address (spoofed traffic is dropped). Strict: additionally drop IPv4 traffic from every device that is not bound. Strict mode needs at least one binding on the interface and can lock out devices you forgot to add: add them first.

field.label: Enforced interfaces
field.help: Interfaces (LAN or VLAN) where bindings are enforced. Defaults to LAN.

field.label: Static ARP entries
field.help: Create permanent ARP entries for bound IP addresses so forged ARP replies are ignored.
